task: T12a authenticated launch handoff and quarantine substrate
scope: T12a only; no T12b, T12c, or product-completion claim
implementation: Added a private protocol-v2 attempt-ready/attempt-decision handshake while retaining protocol-v1 public/native/bridge semantics.
Bound every execution attempt to an authenticated one-use gate token and a decision watchdog capped at 30 seconds inside the compound deadline.
Made malformed, wrong-token, replayed, early, EOF, cancellation, timeout, and uncertain-predecessor paths fail closed before any later child spawn.
Preserved ordinary public execute, run_guard, and history behavior and avoided any legacy configuration, alias, migration, cloud, backend, API, or model path.
Added history-owned typed SelectionQuarantine state, attempt evidence, comparison receipts, strict evidence validation, and exact expected-row quarantine clearing.
Added pure choose_shadow_plans policy selection and quarantine-aware automatic full-mode fallback without clearing unrelated health or corruption markers.
Regenerated the runtime protocol descriptor; protocol-v1 domain meanings remain unchanged and private control/launch schemas are explicitly version 2.
security_negative_contracts: Wrong, malformed, early, or replayed authenticated decisions never launch a child.
EOF, cancellation, watchdog expiry, changed/unknown source identity, and live/unknown descendants close subsequent spawn and retain capacity through the existing finalization boundary.
One-use gate tokens are random, attempt-bound, action-bound, and rejected after consumption.
Private JSON rejects duplicate object keys and non-finite numbers; protocol versions are isolated.
Quarantine publication requires genuine selected/full attempt evidence for the current baseline and runtime identity.

Quarantine clear is an atomic expected-row delete only after a newer qualifying corrected comparison and an intervening matching clean baseline; unrelated health/corruption markers are never widened or cleared.
